#!/bin/bash
# 防复发Git Hooks — Pre-commit Hook
# 命名空间: NGT-HOOKS-v1.0-FIN-260327

# 颜色定义
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

echo "🔍 Running pre-commit checks..."

# 检查1: 敏感信息扫描
echo "📋 Check 1: Scanning for sensitive information..."
SENSITIVE_PATTERNS=(
    "api_key"
    "apikey"
    "api-key"
    "password"
    "passwd"
    "secret"
    "token"
    "ghp_"
    "sk-"
    "AKIA"  # AWS Key
)

FOUND_SENSITIVE=false
for pattern in "${SENSITIVE_PATTERNS[@]}
